title: BoilerPlate
Great achievements cannot be sustained b: Great achievements cannot be sustained by strong will and effort alone. If you expend willpower on everything, you will quickly burn out
Make habits of things that need to be bu: Make habits of things that need to be built up consistently every day. Habits minimize the energy we need to expend and maintain consistency. Through this, you can achieve big goals
When behavior is repeated above a certai: When behavior is repeated above a certain level and becomes a habit, you can automatically perform that action without consuming willpower
Research shows that habit formation take: Research shows that habit formation takes 18 to 254 days, with an average of 66 days. But don't worry! Missing once or twice doesn't significantly impact the overall process. What matters is consistent repetition
What kind of person do you want to becom: What kind of person do you want to become?
First, imagine the person you want to be: First, imagine the person you want to become. Think about sentences that represent your desired identity, such as 'I am a healthier person' or 'I am a more confident person'
Writing down your identity by hand and r: Writing down your identity by hand and reading it repeatedly can help you become closer to that image. This small action becomes the power to transform yourself
Organize your environment and create con: Organize your environment and create consistent context
Habits form more easily in consistent co: Habits form more easily in consistent contexts. When you repeat actions at the same time and place, that context automatically becomes a trigger for the behavior
Make specific plans for time and place. Like 'drinking water in the kitchen at 7 AM', when you set specific actions at consistent times and places, habit formation becomes easier
Reorganizing your environment also helps: Reorganizing your environment also helps. Try connecting specific places with specific actions. For example, developing a habit of reading books at a nearby cafe
Rewards are crucial in initial habit for: Rewards are crucial in initial habit formation. When the brain's reward system is activated, you're more likely to repeat that behavior
Start with small rewards. For example, ': Start with small rewards. For example, 'drinking your favorite coffee after morning walk'. Once the habit is formed, the behavior will naturally continue without rewards
Reward yourself to feel a sense of achie: Reward yourself to feel a sense of achievement. You deserve a reward even after '1 minute of running'. Rewards make actions enjoyable and provide the strength to continue consistently
Creating strong habit chains for your id: Creating strong habit chains for your identity
Once you've set your identity, add and c: Once you've set your identity, add and connect habits that match it. Adding new habits to existing ones makes habit formation easier and leads to greater achievements
Habit formation becomes more natural whe: Habit formation becomes more natural when one action triggers another. For example, try linking '5 minutes of stretching' to 'drinking a glass of water after waking up'
Habits should start as easily as possibl: Habits should start as easily as possible. Lower the entry barrier with actions that can be achieved within 2 minutes. It's easier to increase intensity after the habit is formed
Start with small steps. Habits change yo: Start with small steps. Habits change your life gradually rather than making big changes at once
According to the habit formation model,: According to the habit formation model, context acts as a cue that triggers behavior. When repeated in the same context, the brain recognizes that context as a signal and automatically prepares to perform the behavior.
In the early stages of habit formation,: In the early stages of habit formation, it is effective to provide motivation through small rewards, and create an environment where habits can be maintained without rewards once they are established.
